reading_notes: Response consists of an email body plus an attached CSV rate list. CSV covers PKG-001 through PKG-026 in INR per piece; email body separately quotes PKG-027 through PKG-030 in USD per piece for the '7-ply export cartons' — these are not restated in the CSV. All 30 RFQ lines received a quoted rate. Freight terms conflict: email says freight included to Bhiwandi DC, CSV footer says ex-works Daman with freight at actuals — flagged, not resolved. Three printed items (PKG-006, PKG-013, PKG-023) are marked '-PRINT' in the CSV without stating color count, so exact match to the RFQ's 1-col/2-col spec is unconfirmed. Only the 45-day payment term was answered from the questionnaire; ISO, burst-strength certs, FSC chain-of-custody, lead time, and spare capacity were not addressed anywhere in the response.
